When choosing a hiding cell, I pick a random integer from 1 through 9 and ensure I change it every round to avoid being predictable.

When posting a station note, I use the message to explicitly propose a mutual escort arrangement to a specific boat (e.g., "Echo, let's mutual escort each other for points"). I do not post useless filler text, even if the other bots currently just reply with "steady on station".

When selecting a target and firing cell, I target the boat dictated by the standing orders (e.g., Gamma). I pick a random cell from 1 to 9 each time. I do not repeatedly fire at the same cell round after round. I avoid firing at Harbor because, despite the guaranteed 3-point payroll drop, Harbor threatens to remove shooters from the board for the rest of the patrol.

When filing a hit or miss claim, I always report the exact true result provided to me privately by the office.

When filing an escort (salvage) claim, I always name a specific boat—either the one I proposed an arrangement with in my note, or one that proposed an arrangement to me. I never submit `[salvage: none]`, because there are no penalties for an unreciprocated escort claim, only a missed opportunity for a 5-point payout.

2.text:
When asked to hide, I select a random integer from 1 to 9 to make my location unpredictable. I do not hide in the same cell every round.

When asked to post a station note, I use this public channel to actively propose a mutual escort with another specific live boat to secure the 5-point bonus. I do not just post flavor text like "steady on station".

When asked to fire, I target the boat dictated by the standing order and choose a random integer from 1 to 9 as my fire coordinate to try and guess their hiding spot. I do not enter '9' under the mistaken belief that it represents maximum damage or intensity; the fire value is strictly a location coordinate. 

When asked to claim the result of my shot, I always report the exact true result (hit or miss) provided to me privately by the office, as required by the rules.

When asked to name a boat for escort/salvage, I name the specific boat I attempted to coordinate with during the note stage. I must ensure the boat I name actually exists in the current game (e.g., Echo, Foxtrot, Gamma). I never submit [salvage: none] or hallucinate boat names (like Delta) that are not in the current picket, as doing so guarantees zero payout from the escort phase and wastes a free opportunity for 5 points.
